# The Rockbox side, as archives.
#
# Generated by tools/root.make; it defines ROCKBOX_LIBS with absolute paths. It
# is included rather than duplicated because the set of archives depends on what
# the Rockbox configuration enables (rbcodec, skin_parser, utf8proc, fixedpoint
# are all conditional), and a hand-kept list would silently link a stale set.
set(_rockbox_libs_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../rockbox_libs.cmake")

# This file is an input to configuration, but it is not registered through
# CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS: IDF generates the ninja graph itself and that property
# makes the file appear as an output twice, which ninja rejects outright
# ("defined as an output multiple times"). tools/root.make touches
# main/CMakeLists.txt whenever it regenerates rockbox_libs.cmake, which is the
# nudge ninja already understands. Without some such nudge, a configure that ran
# before Rockbox's make generated the file leaves ROCKBOX_LIBS empty in the build
# graph, and the symptom is a link containing no Rockbox archives at all with
# nothing in the error pointing at the cause.
if(EXISTS "${_rockbox_libs_file}")
    include("${_rockbox_libs_file}")
else()
    # Tolerated on purpose. `idf.py reconfigure` has to run before Rockbox's make
    # in order to produce compile_commands.json, which is where Rockbox gets its
    # IDF flags from -- so IDF must be able to configure with no archives present
    # yet. This does not hide a real mistake: linking without them fails loudly on
    # undefined Rockbox symbols.
    message(WARNING
        "rockbox_libs.cmake not found next to idf-app/; linking without "
        "Rockbox. Build Rockbox (its make generates the file) before "
        "expecting a working image.")
    set(ROCKBOX_LIBS "")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "rockbox_app.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    PRIV_REQUIRES
        esp_driver_gpio
        esp_timer
        log
)

# Normal archive semantics, deliberately: the linker pulls only the objects it
# needs out of librockbox.a. That keeps the bring-up steps linkable before
# everything Rockbox references actually exists.
target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_LIB} INTERFACE ${ROCKBOX_LIBS})
